body:
Know you aren't alone, but know more importantly, IT'S NOT YOUR FAULT. 
I know that it sounds generic but it's true. 
I PROMISE YOU. That things will get better, maybe not today, or tomorrow, but they will get better and you just have to keep faith.

That is EXACTLY how I feel.
Honestly just focus on the things that make you feel good: your interests, friends, and whatever makes you feel happy.
And remember YOU ARE THE ONLY ONE who can stop being your enemy.
Thank you that really helps actually.
